preToolUse.bash:
p=$(cat)
deny() { printf '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by the Copilot kit deny hook: %s"}\n' "$1"; exit 0; }
has() { printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eq "$1"; }
if ! has '"toolName"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(view|create|edit|str_replace_editor|apply_patch)"'; then
has 'git push[^"]*(--force([^-]|$)|[[:space:]]-f("|[[:space:]]|$))' && deny "force-push rewrites shared history; use --force-with-lease on your own branch"
has 'git reset[^"]*--hard' && deny "git reset --hard discards uncommitted work; commit or use git stash"
has 'rm[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*(rf|fr)[a-zA-Z]*[[:space:]]+(/|~/?|\$HOME/?|\./?|\.\./?|\*)("|[[:space:]]|;|&|$)' && deny "rm -rf on a root, home or whole working directory"
fi
has '\.env("|[[:space:]]|$)' && deny "reading or writing .env files can leak secrets; use .env.example"
has '(\.pem|\.key|id_rsa|id_ed25519|id_ecdsa)("|[[:space:]]|$)' && deny "private key files are off limits"
exit 0
